title: AegisOps Fault Ground-Truth Record
description: KNOWN injected fault truth used for deterministic research evaluation, not predicted or measured results.

record_id.description: Stable unique identity of the ground-truth record.

fault_id.description: Identity of the corresponding injected fault.

target_service_id.description: Identity of the service targeted by the injected fault.

expected_root_cause.description: Known root cause intentionally introduced by the experiment.

expected_affected_service_ids.description: Known downstream blast radius. Omission or empty array indicates only target or no known downstream effect.

metadata.description: Freeform JSON-safe research annotations. MUST NOT contain secrets or measured model outputs.
